findings.message: Evidence Discipline requires every finding to quote the exact code, and the Output template has a `**Code:** <quoted line>` field. The agent's own step 4 says files under `.specclaw/changes/` are committed to git. When the finding is a leaked secret, the agent writes the secret into `security-report.md`, which is committed, so the report becomes a second copy of the leak. Add a rule: for secret findings, quote the path and line and redact the value (for example the first 4 characters plus `…`), and never copy the value into the report.
findings.scenario: The diff hard-codes `API_TOKEN = "ghp_abc123..."`. The agent raises a BLOCK under 'Secrets in records' and, as required, writes the full token into `.specclaw/changes/<change>/security-report.md`. The report is committed and pushed, which spreads the credential to more files and history.

findings.message: Step 3.52 tells the orchestrator to write the agent's output to `security-report.md`, but the agent file also says the agent writes that file itself (it has the Write tool). Two writers own the same file. Pick one: either the agent writes it and verify only reads the verdict line, or the agent returns text and drops Write.
findings.scenario: Both the agent and the orchestrator write `security-report.md`. If the agent returns a short summary instead of the full report, the orchestrator overwrites the full report with that summary.

findings.message: The Guardrails say the agent never runs scanners or exploits anything, and it is advisory, but `tools` includes Bash. Nothing in the Method needs Bash, so drop it from the tool list.
findings.scenario: A prompt-injected issue text read during review tells the agent to run a shell command, and the agent can do it because Bash is granted.

findings.message: AC-3 greps for the bare word 'advisory' anywhere in verify.md, so it passes on any other advisory text in the file. Scope the check to the Step 3.52 section, for example by extracting that section with sed before grepping.
findings.scenario: Someone deletes the 'It is advisory' sentence from Step 3.52 and the test stays green because another part of verify.md still contains 'advisory'.
